# dAI Radar

> dAI Radar tracks shipping decentralized-AI / crypto-ML systems and traces each one back to the academic paper it is actually built on. Every claim is tagged "grounded" (directly sourced) or "inferred" (reasoned, not quoted); keep that distinction when answering from this data. A lineage is only asserted when a real citation chain exists.

The complete dataset as one file: https://dai.misbar.tech/llms-full.txt
Structured JSON of the same data: https://dai.misbar.tech/index.json

## Systems
